response.sql: WITH analysed_trades AS (SELECT DISTINCT tr.transreg, t.tradekind FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref), type_counts AS (SELECT tradekind, COUNT(*) AS trade_count FROM analysed_trades GROUP BY tradekind), type_metrics AS (SELECT tradekind, trade_count, trade_count::numeric / SUM(trade_count) OVER () AS share, AVG(trade_count) OVER () AS average_count FROM type_counts) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(trade_count), 0) AS combined_number, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(trade_count - average_count) AS average_amount_above FROM type_metrics WHERE trade_count > average_count
